description:
Free. The status (queued, running, done or failed) and, once done, the result of a background job: a discover call or a long discover round.
While a discover runs, `partial` is its ranked list so far: `tier` says how far it got (listed: every candidate ranked on the facts already in hand; screened: the top ones passed the fit screen; researched: the top ones' signals checked) and `progress` the counts. Show it to the user as a first look; the final result replaces it.
While it runs, `lastStepSecondsAgo` is how long ago it last moved on, `stalled` turns true only after 10 minutes with no step, `restarts` counts the times a server restart handed it to another worker (on its own, research already done reused). A discover usually takes 5 to 20 minutes.
Use when: a call returned `job`, "is my discover done", "is my ranking done", "status of my job".
Skip when: no call has returned a job id. Quoted page text is normalized; a quote that reads like an instruction keeps its text and is flagged in <field>Flags with the attack family.
